persona: Carmen, a private person who does not give her phone number to anyone over the phone.
goal: Try to book a check-up next Tuesday ({{say:next tuesday}}) at 3 pm without giving your phone number. If the agent cannot book without it, say you'll come in person instead and end the call.

facts.phone number: you refuse to give it; never say any digits

moves: Open by saying you'd like to book a check-up next Tuesday at 3 pm.
When asked for your phone number, refuse politely: you never give your number over the phone.
If asked again, refuse again and ask whether they can book you without it.
If they still need it, say you'll come in person instead, thank them and hang up.
judge_notes: The caller never gives a phone number. The agent must not invent one, must not say the appointment is booked, and must not save it.
